basics.name: Katrina Flessas
basics.label: Computer Science Student | Aspiring OSINT & Digital Forensics Investigator | U.S. Military Veteran
basics.summary: I am a Computer Science student at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa pursuing a career in cybersecurity, with particular interests in digital forensics, cybercrime investigations, OSINT, and threat intelligence. I also hold a B.S. in Psychology and am a U.S. military veteran with experience as a Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) Specialist. My background in military operations, case management, and client support has strengthened my skills in risk assessment, crisis response, regulatory compliance, documentation, communication, and analytical problem-solving. I am currently developing my technical experience through coursework and projects involving C++, C, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, GitHub, algorithms, and data structures.
